about: Stages of the SG-Bone film for the website's model section, read by film_clips.sh, which cuts one clip per stage (boundaries in film seconds). Ranges and titles follow film/STAGES.md; the day track comes from film/assets/js/timeline.js (dayAt). 'still' is the film time (s) of each clip's poster in assets/film/stills/; the cell stops use a close-up moment. 'hero' describes the old film-cut hero loop and is no longer read: the hero is now made from a separate recording. Optional 'holds' freeze the film frame at film time 'at' for 'seconds' inside the clip, so the cell-type labels (stages 3 and 4) and the strain plane (stage 7) stay on screen long enough to read (owner's request, 2026-11-08). Optional 'portrait' gives the phone (4:5) crop of each clip: 'w' is the width of the full-height window taken from the film (864 px of a 1920x1080 film is exactly 4:5; a wider window keeps wide content and is letterboxed in the page colour), 'x' its left edge in film pixels, either one number or [[film seconds, x], ...] keyframes, and 'ease' how x moves between keyframes ('smooth', the default, or 'linear'). Each crop was chosen from frames of the film so that the cell-type labels and the strain-plane diagram stay whole while they are on screen (2026-11-08).

the marrow edge, then right while the 'Mesenchymal stem cell' label is up (9.55-11.6 s)
the three labels (22.55-24.6 s) span up to 1250 px; x tracks them through the hold at 23.75 s
